  btn.hidden = false;
  btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Pause diagram animation");
  btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var paused = fig.classList.toggle("is-paused");

<p class="hero-lede">How do religion, values, and everyday experiences affect people's lives? Many questions in psychological science are difficult to study through experiments. At OTTO Lab, we develop and apply methods for causal inference from observational data: learning about the effects of specified changes from what people experience in their lives. Causal interpretation depends on the study design and its assumptions. We also build research tools, teach these methods, and collaborate with investigators across New Zealand and around the world.</p>
